# Vendored Howl Text

Origin: `https://github.com/LaurenceGuws/howl` at commit
`f0da98dca2531b094b8c8d4ca9b1198d7ef23e77`, path `mods/howl-text/`.
Upstream subtree: `d2c3b9389983c838c418e732336906b12fa172d4`.
This directory is an unmodified `git archive` source snapshot, except for this
provenance note. Keep its `LICENSES/` notices and test fonts with upstream source.
Update by importing an exact reviewed upstream commit, never by applying
changes to Zig's package cache. Wayspot remains buildable without the sibling
Howl checkout.
